title: Josiah King
text:
I am currently a lecturer in quantitative methods in psychology at the University of Edinburgh. I coordinate the teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate courses in quantitative methods using R and provide statistical support to students and staff.
I have previously worked for the Scottish Centre for Administrative Data Research (SCADR), and for the Scottish Government. I completed my PhD in Psychology at the University of Edinburgh.
I am open to collaborations and PhD (co-)supervision on anything methods-y. You can contact me at josiah dot king @ed.ac.uk
